name: All In
source:
When an asexual individual decides to dive into a night of enjoyment & kink with a whole suite of interesting people, they get more affection than they could have possibly bargained for.

A visual novel celebrating acespec kinkiness.

[From [url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/all-in]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位無性戀者決定與一群有趣的人，共度充滿歡樂與特殊情趣的夜晚，卻收穫了遠超預期的關愛。

一部頌揚無性戀光譜群體也能享受特殊情趣的視覺小說。

[摘自[url=https://storysinger-presents.itch.io/all-in]Itch.io[/url]]
